description: This Java class handles the unassignment of roles from groups within the Fineract system. It implements the command handler interface, processes the unassign role command, and delegates the core logic to the GroupRolesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UnassignRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the 'UNASSIGNROLE' command for groups, enabling role removal from groups within the system.

methods.name: UnassignRoleCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupRolesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the unassign role command by delegating to the groupRolesWritePlatformService to delete the role based on the command's entity ID.
